scope: Eight active source repos over 100GB at immutable HF commits with training state, backend representations and dataset partition comparison

qwen_coder_next.note: 40 physical shards form ONE model. Do not drop shards to reduce size.

mistral_small4.note: Native versus HF checkpoint layouts from same released model. Different naming and ABI; no tensorwise equivalence recomputation. Choose by target runtime; avoid retaining both formats without technical purpose.

gpt_oss_120b.note: One MXFP4-trained source checkpoint offered as HF converted, reference original and Apple Metal compiled artifact. Backend compatibility differs; not three post-trained models.

flux2_dev.warning: One root transformer and one diffusers sharded transformer appear to represent the same released learned model, but numerical equivalence not independently verified; avoid both by default. Content cannot be pinned until access and source hashes validated.

granary_v2.warning: Repository contains labeled/metadata JSONL, not independent proof that all underlying waveform audio is archived; per-corpus source access must be checked.

rationale: Mistral offers two checkpoint naming formats; GPT OSS original root metal three backend representations; FLUX2 root+Diffusers transformers duplicate model role. IFM and Granary datasets have different provenance/language components not compressions. Gated Scout and Meditron must not be treated as acquired weights.
next_steps: For Mistral Small4 confirm native/HF format equivalence and real backend support, no assumption different tensors are bit-identical.
For gpt-oss choose original vs HF vs Metal based long-term reproducibility and owner hardware, document MXFP4 checkpoint native training.
For FLUX2 gated model find authorized weight hashes and singlefile vs diffusers equivalence; code and text encoder cache cannot be omitted.
For IFM and Granary pick unique data shards by legal provenance, do not count dataset file names as ordinary quant duplication.
